rules.name: L1/L2 data transmission rate
rules.source_quote: The data stream shall be transmitted by the SV on the L1 and L2 channels at a rate of 50 bps.
rules.test_hint: Generate frames at incorrect data rates (not 50 bps) and verify network rejection

rules.name: L2 CM channel data transmission rate with FEC
rules.source_quote: upon ground command, the data stream shall be transmitted by the Block IIR-M SV on the L2 CM channel at a rate of 25 bps using FEC encoding resulting in 50 sps.
rules.test_hint: Test FEC-encoded transmission at rates other than 25 bps and verify network behavior

rules.name: Frame length constraint
rules.source_quote: the message structure shall utilize a basic format of a 1500 bit long frame made up of five subframes, each subframe being 300 bits long.
rules.test_hint: Generate frames with lengths other than 1500 bits and observe network handling

rules.name: Subframe count per frame
rules.source_quote: the message structure shall utilize a basic format of a 1500 bit long frame made up of five subframes
rules.test_hint: Create frames with incorrect number of subframes (not 5) and test network validation

rules.name: Subframe length constraint
rules.source_quote: Each subframe shall consist of ten words, each 30 bits long
rules.test_hint: Generate subframes with lengths other than 300 bits and verify network rejection

rules.name: Word count per subframe
rules.source_quote: Each subframe shall consist of ten words, each 30 bits long
rules.test_hint: Create subframes with incorrect word count (not 10) and test network validation

rules.name: Word length constraint
rules.source_quote: Each subframe shall consist of ten words, each 30 bits long
rules.test_hint: Generate words with lengths other than 30 bits and observe network behavior

rules.name: MSB transmission order requirement
rules.source_quote: DIRECTION OF DATA FLOW FROM SV MSB FIRST
rules.test_hint: Send frames with LSB first bit ordering to test if network devices properly reject or handle incorrect bit ordering

rules.name: Word parity requirement
rules.source_quote: Each word in each frame shall contain parity (reference Section 20.3.5)
rules.test_hint: Send words without parity bits or with incorrect parity and test network validation

rules.name: Subframe transmission duration constraint
rules.source_quote: 150 BITS 3 SECONDS
rules.test_hint: Send subframes with transmission durations other than 3 seconds

rules.name: Parity bit field length constraint
rules.source_quote: P = 6 PARITY BITS
rules.test_hint: Send frames with parity fields containing other than 6 bits

rules.name: Non-information bearing bits for parity constraint
rules.source_quote: t = 2 NONINFORMATION BEARING BITS USED FOR PARITY COMPUTATION
rules.test_hint: Send frames with other than 2 non-information bearing bits used for parity computation

rules.name: TLM field bit length constraint
rules.source_quote: TLM 22 BITS
rules.test_hint: Send frames with TLM fields containing other than 22 bits

rules.name: HOW field bit length constraint
rules.source_quote: HOW 22 BITS
rules.test_hint: Send frames with HOW fields containing other than 22 bits

rules.name: Valid subframe numbers constraint
rules.source_quote: SUBFRAME NO. 1 N/A ... SUBFRAME NO. 2 N/A ... SUBFRAME NO. 3 N/A ... SUBFRAME NO. 5
rules.test_hint: Send frames with subframe numbers outside the range 1-5

rules.name: Subframe 5 page number range constraint
rules.source_quote: SUBFRAME NO. 5 1 THRU 24 ... SUBFRAME NO. 5 25
rules.test_hint: Send subframe 5 with page numbers outside the range 1-25

rules.name: Data ID field bit length constraint
rules.source_quote: DATA ID - 2 BITS
rules.test_hint: Send frames with Data ID fields of incorrect length (more or fewer than 2 bits) to test field validation

rules.name: SV Page ID field bit length constraint
rules.source_quote: SV (PAGE) ID - 6 BITS
rules.test_hint: Send frames with SV Page ID fields of incorrect length (more or fewer than 6 bits) to test field validation

rules.name: SV Health field bit length constraint
rules.source_quote: SV HEALTH - 6 BITS
rules.test_hint: Send frames with SV Health fields of incorrect length (more or fewer than 6 bits per SV) to test health data validation

rules.name: TLM word transmission frequency
rules.source_quote: occurs every six seconds in the data frame
rules.test_hint: Send TLM words at intervals other than 6 seconds

rules.name: Pi constant precision requirement
rules.source_quote: π is a mathematical constant, the ratio of a circle's circumference to its diameter. Here π is taken as π = 3.1415926535898.
rules.test_hint: Use a different precision value for π in calculations and observe if the system accepts or rejects it

rules.name: WGS 84 Earth equatorial radius
rules.source_quote: RE = 6378137.0 meters WGS 84 Earth Equatorial Radius
rules.test_hint: Use a different value for Earth's equatorial radius in position calculations and verify system behavior

rules.name: Oblate Earth gravity coefficient
rules.source_quote: J2 = 0.0010826262 Oblate Earth Gravity Coefficient
rules.test_hint: Modify the J2 gravity coefficient value and test if the system detects the change in gravitational calculations

rules.name: ECEF to ECI coordinate transformation

constraint.value: x = x*cos(θ) - y*sin(θ); y = x*sin(θ) + y*cos(θ); z = z; where θ = Ω̇e*(t - t0)

rules.source_quote: x = x cos(θ) - y sin(θ); y = x sin(θ) + y cos(θ); z = z; where θ = Ω̇e(t - t0)
rules.test_hint: Send coordinate data that doesn't follow the proper transformation equations and verify if the system validates the coordinate conversion

rules.name: GPS signal propagation linearity in ECI

constraint.value: GPS signals propagate in straight lines at constant speed c in ECI coordinate system

rules.source_quote: In an ECI coordinate system, GPS signals propagate in straight lines at the constant speed c
rules.test_hint: Test with signal propagation models that don't assume straight-line propagation or constant speed
